title: Pasting invertible adjunction squares preserves the specified mates
statement: For three horizontal adjunctions La⊣Ra, Lb⊣Rb, Lc⊣Rc, composable scalar adjunctions H⊣S, I⊣T, J⊣U and pullback adjunctions P⊣V, Q⊣W, R⊣Z, assume invertible comparisons between the two right-adjoint routes, their left-adjoint mates, and compatible scalar and pullback composition comparisons. If the right-adjoint comparisons compose, the pasted left-adjoint comparisons compose with exactly the mates of the supplied scalar and pullback composition maps. This is an equality of natural isomorphisms, including all functor associators.

proof.text: Apply injectivity of conjugateIsoEquiv. Conjugating a composite reverses its order; conjugation respects inverse, left and right whiskering, and functor associators. Prove these identities from the unit/counit formulas and the triangle identities in Mathlib.

Rewrite each conjugated comparison using the five supplied mate identities and the right-adjoint pasting equation. Cancel adjacent inverse composition isomorphisms; the two right-adjoint routes agree.
